info.title: Runtime knowledge workspace API
info.description: A division knowledge workspace for humans and agents. Use each operation's operationId or x-agent-tool-name as its stable tool name, and its x-agent-idempotent, x-agent-retryable and x-agent-side-effects flags to decide whether a call may be repeated. Follow a success response's links (HATEOAS) for the next operations instead of constructing URLs. Errors are application/problem+json with a stable code (see x-workspace-codes); a versionConflict carries the current record. Listing endpoints use cursor pagination: pass nextCursor back as cursor and stop when it is null. Unless x-workspace-role is none, send a bearer JWT for that role. /health is an internal probe only: the public ingress forwards only /api/*.

post.description: Validates, freezes and saves a schema 2 assessment draft as version 1, returning its id. Not idempotent: retrying saves another assessment, so read back the returned id instead of retrying blindly. The same refusals as previewAssessment apply.

record.description: Example: raise the claim approval threshold.

503.description: Service Unavailable. Codes: impactUnavailable, snapshotUnavailable, writesPaused

get.description: Cursor-paginated list of saved assessments, newest first, at most 50 per page. Pass the previous page's nextCursor as cursor with the same limit; never invent a cursor. Treat nextCursor=null as the end. pinnedToEarlierSnapshot=true marks an assessment saved on an earlier snapshot.

next.description: Fetch the next page using this page's nextCursor, keeping the same limit.

assessment.description: Open a listed assessment; supply its id.

post.summary: Preview an assessment draft without saving it
post.description: Read-only despite POST: validates a schema 2 assessment draft against the active snapshot's impact model, freezes it with everything it cites, and returns the frozen content and its Markdown. Nothing is stored. Every likely impact must name a node on a cited path and evidence on that path, or a verified inspected view. A snapshotId that is no longer active fails 409 snapshotChanged: the draft belongs to an earlier snapshot, so start again from a new search. Approval and sign-off fields fail 422 approvalNotSupported; the workspace records impact, it does not approve it.

record.description: Example: raise the claim approval threshold.

saveAssessment.description: Save the same draft; requires ManageKnowledgeGraph.

get.description: Returns a saved assessment exactly as it was frozen, with every revision. pinnedToEarlierSnapshot=true means a newer snapshot is active: the assessment still opens unchanged, but it can no longer be edited.

editAssessment.description: Edit it on the same snapshot; supply its version as expectedVersion.

put.description: Revises a saved assessment on the snapshot it was saved on, keeping every earlier version with its editor and time. Optimistic concurrency: expectedVersion must match the current version, or it fails 409 versionConflict; reload and reapply your changes. An assessment saved on an earlier snapshot fails 409 snapshotMismatch: start a new assessment from it instead.

record.description: Example: raise the claim approval threshold.

assessment.description: Read back the edited assessment and its revisions.

503.description: Service Unavailable. Codes: impactUnavailable, snapshotUnavailable, writesPaused

get.description: Returns the saved assessment's Markdown, byte for byte as it was rendered when saved.

assessment.description: Open the saved assessment with its frozen content and revisions.

post.description: Creates an annotation contribution and returns its id and version. Not idempotent: retrying creates another annotation. Follow history for the created id instead of retrying blindly.

example.text: Example: an order is accepted once payment is authorised.

editContribution.description: Revise it; supply id and the returned version as expectedVersion.

removeContribution.description: Remove it; supply id and the current version as expectedVersion.

post.description: Creates a runtime relationship contribution and returns its id and version. Not idempotent: retrying creates another relationship. Follow history for the created id instead of retrying blindly.

meaning.explanation: Example: each accepted order is billed by one invoice.

editContribution.description: Revise it; supply id and the returned version as expectedVersion.

removeContribution.description: Remove it; supply id and the current version as expectedVersion.

associateCodification.description: Codify it against a published relationship; supply id and the current version.

put.summary: Edit an annotation or runtime relationship
put.description: Edits an annotation or runtime relationship. Optimistic concurrency: expectedVersion must match the current version. On a 409 versionConflict, reconcile your intended changes with the current record returned in the response body's current field, then submit a revised edit using that record's version as expectedVersion; do not merely replace expectedVersion on your original changes, which would silently overwrite the other caller's edits.

editContribution.description: Edit it again; supply id and the returned version as expectedVersion.

removeContribution.description: Remove it; supply id and the returned version as expectedVersion.

associateCodification.description: For a runtime relationship only: codify it against a published relationship; supply id and the returned version.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. Codes: endpointUnavailable, invalidAnnotation, invalidCommand, invalidMeaning

post.summary: Associate a runtime relationship with its codifying published relationship
post.description: Associates a runtime relationship with the published relationship that codifies it, at expectedVersion. On a 409 versionConflict, reconcile your intended association with the current record returned in the response body's current field before submitting a revised request; do not merely replace expectedVersion, which could discard the other caller's changes.

history.description: Read back the contribution with its codifications.

editContribution.description: Revise it; supply id and the returned version as expectedVersion.

removeContribution.description: Remove it; supply id and the returned version as expectedVersion.

associateCodification.description: Associate another codification; supply id and the returned version.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. Codes: associationExists, invalidAssociation, invalidCommand

post.description: Removes a contribution at expectedVersion. On a 409 versionConflict, inspect current.removed on the current record in the response body and review that record before deciding whether to retry: it may show another caller's edit to a still-active contribution (retry the removal with its version only if you still intend to remove it), or current.removed may already be true, in which case the removal has happened and no retry is needed. A 404 contributionNotFound is separate: no contribution with that id exists, so do not retry.

post.summary: Get one published entity with its annotations
post.description: Read-only lookup despite POST: the published key is the request body. Returns the entity with its runtime annotations.

traverse.description: Walk relationships from this entity; supply its key as start in a TraversalRequest body.

createAnnotation.description: Annotate this entity; supply its key as target in a CreateAnnotation body.

get.description: Cursor-paginated contribution history, ordered oldest first by journal position. Filter with contributionId to follow one contribution's revisions; pass nextCursor for the next page. Entries are historical revisions, so there is deliberately no edit follow-on here: edit only from a current contribution record (for example a create/edit response).

next.description: Fetch the next page using this page's nextCursor, keeping the same contributionId filter and limit.

post.summary: Trace impact paths from supported leads
post.description: Read-only impact trace despite POST. Starts are lead keys from searchImpact on the same snapshotId; unsupported starts are skipped and reported as gaps. Each path lists its steps in order with the cited evidence and lines, so a later step is never shown as a direct relationship of the start. Gaps say what could not be followed: missing relationship meaning, unlinked terms, unreadable evidence text and coverage gaps; an empty result does not prove no impact. A snapshotId that is no longer active fails 409 snapshotChanged.

viewC4.description: Show a C4 view of a node on a path; supply the same snapshotId.

post.summary: Search the active snapshot for impact leads
post.description: Read-only impact lead search despite POST, paged at 100 leads. Matches node labels and catalog concepts in the active snapshot's impact model; each lead says whether it is supported (by a reviewed C4 mapping or verified evidence) and why, so only supported leads can start a trace. The response's snapshotId pins every later call. When nextCursor is set, submit it as cursor with the same query and exactIri; a cursor for another query fails 422 invalidCursor, and a cursor or snapshotId from an earlier snapshot fails 409 snapshotChanged, which means start again from a new search. 503 impactUnavailable means the active snapshot was published without an impact model.

next.description: Fetch the next page: submit this response's nextCursor as cursor with the same query and exactIri.

traceImpact.description: Trace impact paths from supported leads; supply this response's snapshotId and the leads' keys as starts.

viewC4.description: Show a C4 view of a mapped lead; supply this response's snapshotId.

post.summary: Project a C4 view of a mapped node
post.description: Read-only C4 view despite POST: projects the context, container, component or code level around a node that has a reviewed C4 mapping, as the C4 pilot's view JSON together with its Markdown. A node without a mapping returns an empty view with a no-c4-mapping gap. A snapshotId that is no longer active fails 409 snapshotChanged.

traceImpact.description: Trace impact paths from a node in the view; supply the same snapshotId.

get.summary: List published entities, relationship types and relationships
get.description: Cursor-paginated listing of the published snapshot. Pass the previous page's nextCursor as cursor; never invent a cursor. Treat nextCursor=null as the end.

next.description: Fetch the next page using this page's nextCursor, keeping the same limit.

search.description: Search the same snapshot by meaning; supply a SearchRequest body.

post.summary: Get one published or runtime relationship
post.description: Read-only lookup despite POST. Identify the relationship by published key or by runtime contribution id in the request body.

entityDetail.description: Inspect an endpoint entity; supply its published key as key in an EntityDetailRequest body.

post.summary: Search published entities and annotations by meaning
post.description: Semantic (embedding) search over published entities and annotations despite POST; it changes nothing. Each hit names its entityKey for getEntityDetail.

entityDetail.description: Open a hit; supply the hit's entityKey as key in an EntityDetailRequest body.

get.description: Returns whether the caller's bearer token can read (CanRead) and manage (CanManage) the workspace. Call this first to choose which other tools to offer.

inventory.description: List the published snapshot's entities, relationship types and relationships.

post.summary: Traverse relationships from a published entity
post.description: Read-only graph walk despite POST, paged at 100 paths. Start from a published key, follow direction up to maxDepth. When another page exists the response carries nextCursor and truncated=true (the walk is not proven finished); submit nextCursor as cursor with the same start, direction, maxDepth and includeUnavailable to continue. A malformed or parameter-mismatched cursor fails 422 invalidCursor and a moved-on snapshot or workspace fails 409 staleCursor; both tell you to restart from the first page. A walk whose remaining frontier exceeds the cursor size limit fails 422 invalidTraversal and tells you to restart with a smaller maxDepth or a more specific start.

next.description: Continue the walk: submit this response's nextCursor as cursor with the original start, direction, maxDepth and includeUnavailable.

entityDetail.description: Inspect an entity on a returned path; supply its key in an EntityDetailRequest body.

relationshipDetail.description: Inspect a traversed relationship in detail.

get.description: Internal readiness probe. The public ingress forwards only /api/*, so this endpoint is reachable inside the deployment, not from the public origin; do not use it for public discovery (use x-agent-discovery's /api/* URLs instead). Safe to poll internally; returns {"status":"ready"} when the workspace can serve requests.

session.description: Check what the caller's token may do next.

forbidden.description: Your account does not have the role this operation needs. Code: roleRequired

internalError.description: The workspace could not complete the request.

unauthorized.description: Sign in to use the workspace API. Code: authenticationRequired

unreadableRequest.description: The request body or parameters could not be read. Code: unreadableRequest

bearer.description: An access token from the deployment's identity provider, with the workspace API audience.

health.scope: internal only: the public ingress forwards only /api/*, so use the /api/* URLs above from the public origin

x-agent-discovery.auth: bearer JWT; the required role is each operation's x-workspace-role
x-agent-discovery.pagination: cursor: pass nextCursor as cursor and keep the original contributionId and limit, stop when null
x-agent-discovery.errors: application/problem+json with a stable code per operation's x-workspace-codes
x-agent-discovery.hateoas: follow each success response's links and the runtime Link response headers

linkRelations.next: listInventory, listHistory, assessmentList, traverseGraph or searchImpact: the next page of the same listing, walk or search (registered relation)
